notes.title: Update 1.0.21 - Controller Support
notes.notes:
Controller support is now in-game! There were also some bug fixes and tweaks which are listed further down.

Right now the game supports two controller layouts, Xbox and Playstation. You can use other controllers, although they may not work 100% as expected. The game will detect some of your controller input right away, but you’ll still want to select your preferred layout under the controls menu to get all the buttons working correctly. Also, you can use the mouse sensitivity slider in the options menu to adjust the sensitivity of the right joystick.

There is also an invert option available as well, and you can even invert the mouse if you like.

[u][b]Limitations[/b][/u]


Skin Witch wasn’t designed with controller support in mind, so there are some limitations with the controller input system worth noting:
[list]
[*] As noted above, you'll probably need to use your mouse to select your controller preference in the controls menu. After that it [i]should[/i] remember your choice.

[*] Controller input should work for all menus in the game, except for language options. If you need to change the game’s language, you’ll have to select it with your mouse, but you can use your controller for everything else. This will probably be fixed soon.

[*] Limited re-mapping. Many of the controller inputs can be remapped, although a few can’t. To re-map buttons, use the input tab on the popup window that comes up when you first launch the game.

[*] Menus are navigated using the joysticks. D-pad support may be coming for menu navigation, although it’s not certain.

[*] No key prompts. When the game gives you hints on what key to press, it only shows the corresponding mouse/keyboard key, not the controller key.
[/list]


[u][b]Tweaks / Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the death screen wouldn't let you load a save
[*] Fixed an issue where starting a new game from the death screen left the loading screen up
[*] The storage slots now highlight and un-highlight as intended
[*] When clicking an item in storage, the ‘Take’ button now highlights in red when you hover on it with your mouse or controller
[*] Propane now correctly shows its quantity when stored
[*] A blocked door in Mine 3F now correctly says that it’s jammed
[*] Maps now show the name of the floor you’re on
[/list]


Corey

notes.title: Update 1.0.19
notes.notes:
Here's what's been fixed in the past week:

[list]
[*] Keys now show a trash icon in the bottom right corner if they've unlocked all their respective doors, letting you know you can safely discard them
[*] Fixed some missing translations for a couple menu options
[*] Fixed the save menu showing duplicates of your save files when you first created the save
[*] Fixed a missing translation for the save files menu
[*] Polished the save/load menu, it now highlights which save you selected and responds more clearly
[*] Tweaked the storage interface slightly
[*] Fixed missing music in a couple of the save rooms
[*] Fixed the Witch-Spear item sometimes not triggering on use
[*] Improved memory usage
[/list]


[b]New Feature: Map System[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36091835/9a60f96ac9a57f31f87e7be2e00031ab4b7790f0.jpg[/img]

I also added a new map system, which can be brought up by pressing 'M'. The map will keep track of locked doors you've encountered, and will change the door's icon on the map if you've unlocked it. Naturally the map will also change depending on which floor you're on.

I'll be making some more little improvements to the map next week, maybe adding a legend to it and things like that.

The next major thing I'll be working on is a Linux build, I hope to have that ready soon. 

Have a good weekend!

Corey

notes.title: Performance Improvements - Update 1.0.16
notes.notes:
The work I've done over the past couple days has primarily been on improving performance and reducing lag, with a couple other fixes as well. Here's what's changed:

[list]
[*] Improved graphics performance, the load on the graphics card should be greatly reduced
[*] RAM usage should be lower, although there's still more improvements coming for this
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped the health/heart icon from beating
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow you to change the music volume from the start menu
[/list]

If you're having issues with lag, relaunch the game and change your graphics settings to a lower setting and see if that fixes it. If you just barely meet the system requirements, you'll probably need to set it to 'Very Low'. That should solve most issues, however some more optimizations are coming which should improve performance more as well.

The rest of the week I'll be working more on performance, AI pathfinding, and possibly a map system. A Linux port should be coming relatively soon as well.

Talk to you next time,

Corey

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.0.14
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made your melee attacks frequently miss despite hitting an enemy. Melee attacks now register hits against enemies accurately. Melee is weaker than using your guns however, so be careful.
[*] You can now combine two healing herbs together to save inventory space. You can also combine that mixture together with Ash to make Sacred Herbs, just like when using 1 herb.
[*] Fixed a bug where dead enemies sometimes came back after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented not-quite-so-dead enemies from coming after you.
[/list]

The next tasks on the list will be optimization and performance, and any other bug fixes that are needed. Sometime next week I'll start working on Mac/Linux ports of the game.

Have a great weekend!

Corey

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to say that I just pushed a new update for the game, version 1.0.10, that fixes a lot of things. I had previously run into a problem shortly after release that delayed me in getting out new updates, but that problem was solved yesterday and I'm now pumping out updates pretty regularly. 

[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when storing weapons, it now works correctly
[*]The first 5-10min of gameplay are now more direct as to where you should go
[*]Improved enemy AI behaviors
[*]Fixed a bug that could let you pick up infinite ammo
[*]Ammo in general was too scarce, ammo is now slightly more plentiful
[*]Inventory now shows a prompt to close it: Tab or RMB
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused dead enemies to block your path
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the ore crusher to stop working when removing ore from it
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused enemy corpses to react when being shot
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Controls menu to stay visible when pausing the game again
[*]Fixed a bug where the flamethrower removed the wrong ammo when reloading
[*]Other minor tweaks

[/list]

In addition, a few optimizations were made, and more are coming as well.

Thanks,

Corey

notes.title: Info on Updates
notes.notes:
Hey guys, an issue has popped up with Unity and it's causing me some big delays on creating new game builds.  That said, I'm working constantly to get it straightened out, and I hope to have a new update out very soon.

Thanks, enjoy the rest of your weekend!

notes.title: Release Pushed to May 29th
notes.notes:
Skin Witch needs more time for bug-fixing. I was optimistic it could release on the 22nd, but it's just not in the cards. I'd rather release the game a week later with more polish then release it Friday with a ton of bugs, it's a hard decision but it'll be a better game in the end.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SCy1a1y.jpg[/img]

The game's content is finished, but there are a few systems that need some refinement and polish. This will also provide time for more testing which is always a good thing.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ib9tDeY.jpg[/img]


Thanks,
Corey

notes.title: Skin Witch Hitting Steam May 22nd
notes.notes:
Skin Witch now has an official release date, May 22nd. The game will be PC only at launch, with Mac/Linux ports to follow shortly after release. The game features multiple weapons, enemies, unique puzzles, horrific rituals,  and destructible tunnels. There are also multiple areas including mines, an old bunker, and of course, the lair of the Skin Witch. The game will feature multiple difficulties and endings.

This is a really exciting time, but also stressful. Crunch time is here! If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at:

contact@blackwoodspecter.com

Or simply respond to this announcement. See you in a few weeks!

Corey
Blackwood Specter
Twitter: @BlackwoodSpect
